actualFirstYearContent.mechanics: Classical mechanics/special relativity, free-body diagrams, physical/mathematical models, quantitative solution and validity.
actualFirstYearContent.thermodynamics: First/second laws, enthalpy/entropy, real/ideal media, open/closed systems, industrial cycles, maximal work and sustainable-energy applications.
actualFirstYearContent.electromagnetism: Electrostatics/magnetostatics in vacuum/matter, field and potential theory, Gauss/Ampere/Maxwell/induction and time-dependent systems.
actualFirstYearContent.waves: 1D/2D/3D wave equations, optics/lenses/polarization, interference/coherence/diffraction/dispersion and mechanical/electromagnetic waves.
actualFirstYearContent.mathematics: Single/multivariable analysis, differential equations, vector integral theorems, Fourier/convolution and linear algebra/SVD.
actualFirstYearContent.laboratories: Mechanical models compared with measurement; uncertainty propagation, instrument use and independent thermodynamic investigations; data analysis and scientific reporting.
actualFirstYearContent.designEngineering: Physics-based instrument/setup design, simulation/reality comparison, fabrication/prototyping, tolerances, workshops, feedback and project realization. Engineering description is empty but its actual extensive learning objectives were read.
